title: ngramx: run worktree hooks before environment spin-up, not after
summary: Verified hook execution order and documented migration from onWorktreeCreate to onPreEnvironment

changes.description: Added execution order section showing complete hook sequence and migration guidance
Updated hook examples to show onPreEnvironment for TMUX and added explanatory comments
Created comprehensive migration guide with step-by-step instructions and Rob's TMUX example
Documented investigation, verification, and changes made

verification.code_review: Reviewed src/Command/ReviewCommand.php lines 551-952 to confirm hook execution order
verification.implementation_status: Feature already implemented in v2.61.0 (PR #70, commit 2eb23d7)
verification.hook_order_verified: onPreEnvironment runs before environment startup (line 566), onWorktreeCreate runs at the end (line 943)

migration_path.example: Move TMUX window creation from onWorktreeCreate to onPreEnvironment in ~/.ngramx.yaml
migration_path.benefit: Start working immediately while Docker environment spins up in parallel

notes: No code changes required - feature was already implemented
Migration is backward compatible - onWorktreeCreate still works as before
Users can migrate at their convenience - no breaking changes
